criteria.text: The participant is over 70 years of age

source.text: Patients who are over 70 years of age may be allowed to enroll after discussion with the Medical Monitor.

criteria.text: The participant has a historically or pathologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic Stage IV NSCLC without EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 genomic alterations.

source.text: Have historically or pathologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic Stage IV NSCLC without EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 genomic alterations.

criteria.text: The participant has actionable mutations (other than EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 genomic alterations) and has received 1 additional line of therapy with the appropriate health authority approved targeted therapy.

source.text: For patients who have actionable mutations (other than EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 genomic alterations), 1 additional line of therapy with the appropriate health authority approved targeted therapy is required.

criteria.text: The participant has documented radiographic disease progression on or after the first-line therapy, including concurrent or sequential ICI and platinum-based chemotherapy ± bevacizumab.

source.text: Patients must have documented radiographic disease progression on or after the first-line therapy, including concurrent or sequential ICI and platinum-based chemotherapy ± bevacizumab.

criteria.text: The participant has received no more than 1 prior line of therapy if ICI and platinum-based chemotherapy were administered concurrently, and no more than 2 prior lines of therapy for sequential administration of platinum-based chemotherapy and ICI as 2 separate lines.

source.text: No more than 1 prior line is allowed if ICI and platinum-based chemotherapy were administered concurrently and no more than 2 prior lines are allowed for sequential administration of platinum-based chemotherapy and ICI as 2 separate lines.

criteria.text: The participant has residual resectable disease after completion of the platinum-based chemotherapy component of the front-line ICI and platinum-based chemotherapy combination, meets all eligibility criteria except documented disease progression, and intends to receive TIL therapy after disease progression.

source.text: LN-145 manufacture is allowed for patients who have residual resectable disease after completion of the platinum-based chemotherapy component of the front-line ICI and platinum-based chemotherapy combination and meet all eligibility criteria except documented disease progression. These patients must intend to receive TIL therapy after disease progression

criteria.text: Prior systemic therapy in the adjuvant or neoadjuvant setting, or as part of definitive chemoradiotherapy, counts as a line of therapy if the patient had disease progression during or within 12 months after the completion of such therapy.

source.text: Prior systemic therapy in the adjuvant or neoadjuvant setting, or as part of definitive chemoradiotherapy, will count as a line of therapy if the patient had disease progression during or within 12 months after the completion of such therapy.

criteria.text: The participant has at least 1 resectable lesion for TIL production and at least one remaining measurable lesion, as defined by RECIST v1.1.

source.text: At least 1 resectable lesion for TIL production and at least one remaining measurable lesion, as defined by RECIST v1.1
